# One checkout-relative path per line. A trailing / covers every test beneath a
# directory. Give the reason in a comment above the entry. Listed tests still
# run, and an unexpected pass or a missing path fails the suite.
# When Ekuma follows a specification, name the rule and what the test expects.

# Ekuma follows ECMA-402's rules for primary identifiers in the IANA time zone
# database. From 2024b through 2026c, CST6CDT, EST5EDT, MST7MDT and PST8PDT
# linked to America/Chicago, America/New_York, America/Denver and America/Los_Angeles,
# respectively. Since 2026d these are zones again. The test expects the old links.
# Remove this entry when test262 updates the test.
test/intl402/Temporal/ZonedDateTime/links.js

# Ekuma follows ECMA-262, which leaves the approximation of Math.sinh to the
# implementation. The test expects fdlibm's precision.
test/staging/sm/Math/sinh-approx.js

# Ekuma follows ECMA-262 Annex B and preserves the arguments object when a block
# declares a function named arguments. These tests expect the function to replace
# the arguments object, as in SpiderMonkey. The Annex B behavior is checked by
# test/annexB/language/function-code/block-decl-func-skip-arguments.js.
test/staging/sm/lexical-environment/block-scoped-functions-annex-b-arguments.js
test/staging/sm/regress/regress-602621.js
